You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order with their section headings removed. File every sentence under one of these four headings: SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE EXAM, OBJECTIVE RESULTS, ASSESSMENT AND PLAN. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

SECTION DEFINITIONS
- SUBJECTIVE: what the patient reports and the history taken before the examination: the reason for the visit, the history of the present illness, the review of systems, past medical, surgical, family and social history, current medications and allergies.
- OBJECTIVE EXAM: what the clinician found on physical examination at this visit, including vital signs measured at the visit.
- OBJECTIVE RESULTS: results of laboratory tests, imaging and other studies that were reviewed.
- ASSESSMENT AND PLAN: the clinician's diagnoses or impressions, the reasoning behind them, treatment decisions, prescriptions, orders, referrals, patient instructions and follow-up.
A sentence goes under the heading that names its role in the note, not its topic. A symptom the patient reports belongs under SUBJECTIVE even if the plan discusses it again; a sentence that restates a symptom or finding to justify a decision belongs under ASSESSMENT AND PLAN.

<sentences>
S1: Hill is a 41-year-old female who presents today for an evaluation of right middle finger pain after she was rear-ended in a motor vehicle accident.
S2: Examination of the right middle finger shows tenderness over the distal phalanx.
S3: X-rays of the right middle finger, 3 views obtained on today's visit shows a comminuted distal phalanx fracture.
S4: At this point, I discussed the diagnosis and treatment options with the patient.
S5: All questions were answered.
S6: I recommend a prescription for Tramadol 50 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, dispense 8.
S7: She is provided a finger splint and will return in 2 weeks for a follow-up x-ray.
S8: Right middle finger distal phalanx fracture.
S9: She has no other injuries.
S10: Right middle finger pain.
</sentences>
